reference.author: Mike Kasberg
reference.units: mm assumed; corroborated by source sheet dimensions, STL contains no units

mapping.sheet: Default peg thickness 1.6 mm, adjustable to 2.0; deck thickened to 2.0–2.6.
mapping.socket: Nine 4.5 mm peg tongues, sockets (4.5+fit) × (sheet+fit); default .15 mm TOTAL allowance is proposed rather than measured .10 mm.
mapping.runner: 40 accessible .8–1.4 mm wide × .4–.6 mm thick runners, thickened from source .21/.22 mm; every runner lies outside tongues and band notches.

originalDesign.assembly: Nine downward tongues insert through deck to flush bottom; shoulders touch top, fixed adhesive seats. External slack elastic/yarn traces patterns below notched heads.
originalDesign.personalization: Protected deck front landing centre (0,10), radius 6.5 mm; .4–.6 mm actual image-heightfield or exact accepted STL engraving; >=1.4 mm backing.

differences: Not an unchanged cat kit or prior clapper/loom. New nine-peg pattern field, notched band guide heads, ten-part carrier with 40 runners; no weaving heddle, shuttle, cord hinge or moving printed mechanism. Generic studio/import/serialization infrastructure adapted from 20261031-22; all deck/peg/packing/assembly/check geometry is new.
sourceDefects: 27 edge-adjacent components, nonwatertight. Used as design reference only; original CSG reconstruction, no automatic repair.
